cascade_model.description: Random multiplicative energy cascade (multifractal beta/log-normal model)

files.cascade_K41_S_p.npy: shape (6, 20), structure functions S_p for p=1..6

cascade_model.physics: Controls anomalous scaling of structure functions. K41: zeta_p=p/3. Log-normal: zeta_p=p/3 - mu*p(p-3)/18. The spectral exponent xi = 1 + zeta_2/2 connects to Kraichnan model.

lorenz96.description: Lorenz-96 model: N=40 variables, F=8, deterministic turbulence analogue

rg_flow.description: RG coarse-graining flow from Kraichnan xi=1.5 data

files.rg_char_func_kraichnan_xi1p5.npy: Characteristic functions at multiple time lags
files.rg_alpha_eff.npy: Effective alpha extracted at each tau

rg_flow.physics: The effective alpha should flow from 2 (ballistic) at small tau to 2/xi=1.333 at large tau, demonstrating RG flow to the Lévy-stable fixed point.
